note: Huron County MI (26063) publishes parcels only through the FetchGIS web viewer (app.fetchgis.com), a fee-based per-item service (record details, parcel PDFs, CSV exports at about \$3 per item) with no public ArcGIS REST, WFS, or bulk download. County GIS page lists no REST endpoints. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches for Huron County and Michigan statewide parcels returned no county-run parcel feature service. Remaining parcel sources are commercial vendors (Regrid, Dynamo, Mapping Solutions, ReportAll, Acres), which do not count as county publication.
